item.title: Russian man arrested in Pattaya for alleged illegal cannabis processing operation
item.description: PATTAYA, Thailand – Immigration police in Chonburi Province have arrested a Russian national accused of operating an illegal cannabis production and processing site in the Jomtien area of Pattaya. item.description: PATTAYA, Thailand – Officials from Pattaya have carried out inspections of school buses used by municipal schools to ensure the highest level of safety for students and teachers. item.title: Sommergewitter über Thailand erwartet – Böiger Wind und Blitze auch in Pattaya möglich
